title: Finance settings
description: Operator settings of the finance module (docs/module-wiring.md#settings). Secrets are never settings (they come from the module's Secret).

base_currency.description: Reporting currency; defaults to company.yaml organisation.currency, else USD. Every document stores its FX rate to it: change it only before the first invoice.

x-can.risk: the reporting currency changes, and FX rates already stored are against the old one

payment_instructions.description: Default 'how to pay' text printed on invoices (bank details, payment link text).

name.description: Name printed on invoices; defaults to organisation.legal_name, else the company name.

address.description: Address printed on invoices; defaults to organisation.address.

tax_id.description: Tax number printed on invoices; defaults to organisation.tax_id.

public_base_url.description: Prefix of the signed invoice links, for example https://billing.example.com (no trailing slash). The host can-core routes with expose.public: true takes its place.

x-can.risk: the invoice links sent to customers point there

payment_provider.description: fake is for development only; real adapters are separate modules.

x-can.risk: a development stand-in answers as if it were a real provider
a development stand-in answers as if it were a real provider

retention_years.description: Years financial records are kept after their own date; 0 keeps them forever. Check your jurisdiction: this is not legal advice.

audit_retention_days.description: At least 365, or 0 to keep everything.

x-can.risk: the audit trail is deleted sooner

trust_proxy.description: Use the right-most X-Forwarded-For entry (set by Traefik) as the client address for rate limiting. Enable only behind a proxy that appends the client address.

x-can.risk: client addresses are taken from a request header

max_body_bytes.description: Largest API request accepted, in bytes.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Requests per API token per minute; 0 disables.

x-can.risk: the request limit per API token is switched off

auth_failures_per_minute.description: Failed authentications and bad invoice links per client address per minute before the address is throttled; 0 disables. Valid credentials are never throttled by this.

x-can.risk: more password and link guessing is let through

webhook_url.description: Where signed finance events are POSTed. Needs CAN_FINANCE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

x-can.not_applied: an installed module's events go to can-core, and no webhook secret is provisioned

signing_record_ip.description: Client address kept with a contract signature: truncated, full or none.

x-can.risk: more of signers' IP addresses is stored

idle_minutes.description: Web UI: sign out after this many minutes without activity (default 30).

x-can.risk: idle web sessions stay signed in longer

absolute_hours.description: Web UI: the longest a session lasts (default 8).
